description: This file contains the main React component for the application's journey/roadmap page, including UI elements for visualizing career pathways, milestones, and an interactive mind map. It defines types, state management functions, and several sub-components for rendering and user interaction.

classes.name: RoadmapTab
classes.description: Union type representing different tabs within the roadmap interface.

classes.name: SkillDelta
classes.description: Type representing changes in a skill's current and target levels.

classes.name: MilestoneStatus
classes.description: String literal type indicating milestone completion status.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Type defining a career milestone with various attributes.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Type defining a role-specific career development plan, including skills and milestones.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads saved roadmap state from local storage, returning active role ID and plan array.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to local storage.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Generates a default RolePlan object for a given roleId.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Builds mind map categories based on the role's title and ID, including subs and colors.

methods.name: normalizeMilestonesForPathway
methods.description: Enhances milestones with stages for pathfinding visualization.

methods.name: categoryIcon
methods.description: Returns corresponding SVG icon based on category label.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Computes nodes and edges for the mind map visualization based on expanded categories.
